rows.name: H4_veinsX_W16_r0
rows.rationale: column rule: veins alone carry SF_vein 0.398 x 28.9 = 11.5 N/m, the fine level adds SF_fine 0.402 x 16.5; peak 18.2 N/m, residual fraction 0.63. Hypothesis: the round-pore fine level fails first (~0.12 strain) and the veins keep carrying >= 0.6 of the peak with post-peak energy >= 1.5 x the one-level control (0.21 J/m2, S2_ellipse_90deg); phase-1 square-vein W16/W20 (veins also across the load) did not show it (residual 0.79 then fracture within 0.025 strain; single avalanche)

rows.name: H2_seamX_s20_r0
